description:
Our Story & Mission
Labboho is devoted to celebrating the timeless beauty and cultural legacy of Morocco. Rooted in the rich traditions of Moroccan artisanship, our mission is to source and share authentic, handcrafted products—from exquisite rugs and textiles to unique ceramics and decorative accents. We believe in empowering artisan communities, preserving ancient techniques, and delivering high-quality, ethically made pieces that tell a story.

Heritage & Authenticity

  • Cultural Legacy: Our collections—ranging from Beni Ourain and Boujaad to Tamegroute ceramics—reflect centuries-old traditions steeped in history.

  • Artisan Expertise: Every piece is handcrafted by skilled artisans using time-honored techniques passed down through generations.

  • Authentic Materials: We source only the finest natural materials such as 100% wool, cotton, cactus silk, and locally mined clays and metals, ensuring each product embodies the natural beauty of Morocco.

Our Collections

  • Rugs & Textiles: Whether it’s the minimalist charm of Beni Ourain rugs, the vibrant designs of Boujaad runners, or the intricate patterns of vintage Moroccan textiles, our rug collections are designed to transform interiors with warmth and character.

  • Pottery & Ceramics: Our handcrafted ceramics, from Safi to Marrakech, offer striking glazes, intricate patterns, and a unique blend of traditional craftsmanship with contemporary aesthetics.

  • Decor & Accessories: Our range of mirrors, cushions, and pompom blankets highlight the artistry of Moroccan decor, adding unique, statement touches to any space.

Ethical & Sustainable Practices

  • Fair Trade Sourcing: We work directly with artisan cooperatives and small-scale producers in Morocco, ensuring fair compensation and sustainable practices.

  • Eco-Friendly Materials: Our products are crafted with natural materials and eco-conscious methods, preserving both the environment and traditional techniques.

  • Empowering Communities: Every purchase supports local artisans and helps sustain communities where traditional crafts are a way of life.

Design Philosophy

  • Timeless Aesthetics: Labboho blends the allure of ancient Moroccan artistry with modern design sensibilities.

  • Unique Craftsmanship: Every piece is one-of-a-kind; slight variations in pattern, texture, or color emphasize its handcrafted nature and rich heritage.

  • Versatility & Style: Our collections are designed to complement a wide range of interior styles—from modern minimalist and Scandinavian to bohemian and eclectic—ensuring there’s something for everyone.

Why Choose Labboho?

  • Authenticity: Each product is a genuine reflection of Morocco’s cultural heritage and artistic traditions.

  • Quality: We maintain rigorous quality standards to ensure that every piece is durable, beautiful, and a true work of art.

  • Connection: When you choose Labboho, you're not only buying a product; you’re embracing a piece of history and supporting artisan communities that have refined their craft for generations.

Join Us on Our Journey
Experience the magic of Moroccan craftsmanship with Labboho. Discover our curated collections and find that perfect piece to add warmth, beauty, and a story to your home. Follow our journey as we continue to bring ethically sourced, handcrafted Moroccan treasures to the world.

Payment Schedule
Affiliate commissions are processed and paid on the first Monday of every month. Payments will be issued only for commissions accrued during the previous calendar month.
